'''European Quake League Cup 4''' is a [[4on4]] event that takes place during January and March 2025. 
{{Tabs static
|name1=Overview
|link1=EQL cup 4
|name2=Information
|link2=EQL cup 4/Information
|This=1

EQL cup 4 is the fourth short version of a tournament held by EQL. The tournament starts on the 12th of January and will end the 9th of March. All episode maps are allowed, including [[start]] and [[end]], but decider maps are played on [[TB3]].
